files.basis: EXCLUDED by rule: the name contains 'key'. The file is LISTED so the exclusion is visible — an exclusion nobody can see looks exactly like a file that was never there — and its content was never read
NOT_READ: pypdf is installed but this module does not yet call it. Reporting INDEXED here would claim a read that did not happen

INDEXED: read as UTF-8 text and reduced to 13 lexical token(s) and 3 located passage(s), each carrying its line number so a claim can be traced to a place in the document and not merely to the document. No embedding was computed

INDEXED: read as UTF-8 text and reduced to 6 lexical token(s) and 2 located passage(s), each carrying its line number so a claim can be traced to a place in the document and not merely to the document. No embedding was computed

bounds.passage_basis: a document contributes at most 400 located passages; a file longer than that is indexed to that line and the file's own entry says so, because a cap nobody is told about reads as a complete index
exclusion_rules: a .pem file is a certificate or private key
bounds.basis: at most 2000 files are listed and at most 2097152 bytes are read from any one of them. A file beyond the size cap is listed as NOT_READ with the cap named, not silently truncated, because a half-read file in a search index answers questions about a document nobody has

body.search_basis: search is this platform's OWN LEXICAL index — exact token matching, no embedding, no stemming and no synonyms; this index uses no embedding model, so it is not semantic recall and must not be read as it
body.counts_basis: 2 indexed, 1 not read, 1 excluded, 4 listed in total. Every listed file carries exactly one state and the three counts sum to the total — a file in no state would be a file this manifest had lost
body.locality_basis: this index is LOCAL DATA under the data directory. It is never committed and nothing in this module sends it anywhere
